description: §19.9.1 / §19.9.4 (RUNTIME, real server bundle) — a SERVER-side `fail .Down("queue full")` of a SINGLE-field variant reaches the CLIENT `!{ | ::Down(reason) :> … }` arm with `reason` bound to the payload value. The server fn is placed on the server by its `?{}` read (§12 Trigger 1); the seeded `outbox` table is empty, so it fails. Pre-fix (s441 D2) the server bundle emitted `data: "queue full"` (raw) while the client arm read `data.reason`, so @msg was "down: undefined".
rationale:
§19.9.1: the server serializes a failure as `{ __scrml_error: true, type, variant, data: { ... } }` — the canonical `fail`-expression envelope, `.data` field-keyed. §19.9.4: "Client code SHALL handle server function errors identically to local function errors. The serialization boundary SHALL be transparent to the developer." `serverDb` runs the REAL emitted server bundle (the `serverStub` directive would translate a hand-written envelope and hide the server emit). @msg is consumed by the

interpolation; the assertion is state-only.
